states.name: q
states.meaning: Current decade count value 0 through 9, also the 4-bit output q.
states.update_time: on posedge clk after evaluating reset and count; sample after the edge has settled

rules.condition: reset == 1 implies q = 0 after posedge clk
rules.spec_quote: active high synchronous, and should reset the counter to 0

rules.condition: reset == 0 implies q = (previous q + 1) mod 10 after posedge clk
rules.spec_quote: counts from 0 through 9, inclusive, with a period of 10

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: the first posedge with reset == 0; normal count applies on that edge

mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.
